questions.question: 📞 Sami calls Mina: 'I have a patient with a deep cavity under a crown! Should I redo the crown or repair?' Mina replies: 'Start by assessing the extent.' When can we repair under a crown?
options: If the cavity is peripheral and accessible without removing the crown
Never, the crown must always be removed
Always, we can repair without removing
Only if the crown is ceramic
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Accessible peripheral cavities can be repaired without removing the crown.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will assess the extent of the cavity.'

questions.question: 🏥 Sami and Mina receive a patient with a cusp fracture. Sami says: 'Crown!' Mina replies: 'And the onlay?' What is the difference between an onlay and a crown?
options: The onlay is more conservative and only covers part of the tooth
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'The onlay preserves more tooth structure than a crown.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you've become conservative!'

questions.question: 🗣️ Sami, discussing with a patient, says: 'Your composite will last 10 years.' Mina intervenes: 'If hygiene is good!' What is the key factor in composite longevity?
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The longevity of composites depends on hygiene and follow-up.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will insist on hygiene.'

questions.question: 📞 Mina calls Sami: 'I have a patient with post-operative sensitivity after a composite!' Sami replies: 'It's normal!' Mina says: 'Not necessarily!' What is the most frequent cause?
options: Only the depth of the cavity
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Sensitivities are often due to technical defects.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will check my adhesion.'

questions.question: 🏥 Sami and Mina receive a patient with recurrent caries. Sami says: 'We need to redo the entire restoration!' Mina replies: 'What if we repaired it?' When can we repair recurrent caries?
options: If the cavity is small and localized, a repair is possible
Only if the restoration is composite
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Small recurrent caries can be repaired.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you are pragmatic!'

questions.question: 🗣️ Sami, talking to a patient, says: 'The ceramic inlay is the best choice.' Mina intervenes: 'It is more fragile depending on occlusal forces.' Where to place a ceramic inlay?
options: On premolars or molars with controlled occlusion
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Ceramic is indicated for aesthetics but is more fragile in high-load areas.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate the occlusion.'

questions.question: 📞 Sami calls Mina: 'I have a patient with a cavity under a veneer!' Mina replies: 'Can we repair it?' When can a veneer be repaired?
options: If the cavity is small and does not affect aesthetics
Never, the veneer must be remade
Only if the veneer is composite
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Small cavities under veneers can be repaired.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate the possibility of repair.'

questions.question: 🏥 Sami and Mina receive a patient with a composite that has come off. Sami says: 'It's the patient's fault!' Mina replies: 'It might be an adhesion defect.' What is the most frequent cause?
options: Contamination of the adhesive or poor isolation
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Detachments are often due to adhesion defects.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you are honest!'

questions.question: 🗣️ Sami, during a consultation, says: 'For your root-treated tooth, we need a post and core.' Mina asks: 'What if we just did a composite?' What is a post and core?
options: A core build-up to anchor a crown
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'The post and core reinforces the root-treated tooth to receive a crown.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you're right, it's the most durable solution.'

questions.question: 📞 Mina calls Sami: 'I have a patient with a deep root cavity!' Sami replies: 'Glass ionomer!' Mina says: 'Why not composite?' Which material is most indicated?
options: Glass ionomer for its chemical adhesion and fluoride release
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Glass ionomer is ideal for root cavities.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use glass ionomer.'

questions.question: 🏥 Sami and Mina receive a patient with a cavity under a bridge. Sami says: 'We need to redo the bridge.' Mina replies: 'What if we repaired it?' When can we repair under a bridge?
options: If the cavity is accessible and does not affect the abutments
Never, the bridge must be remade
Only if the bridge is ceramic
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Accessible cavities under a bridge can be repaired.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you are open-minded!'

questions.question: 🗣️ Sami, discussing with a patient, says: 'Nanohybrid composite is the best.' Mina intervenes: 'It's more expensive and requires precise technique.' What are the advantages of nanohybrid?
options: Better polishability, increased resistance, and superior aesthetics
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Nanohybrids offer excellent aesthetic performance.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use nanohybrid for this patient.'

questions.question: 📞 Sami calls Mina: 'I have a patient with a cavity under a temporary crown!' Mina replies: 'Check the sealing.' Why is sealing crucial?
options: To avoid bacterial infiltration and recurrent caries
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Sealing is the key to the longevity of restorations.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will check the sealing of my crowns.'

questions.question: 🏥 Sami and Mina receive a patient with a fractured tooth. Sami says: 'We need a crown.' Mina replies: 'And the onlay?' When is an onlay indicated?
options: When the fracture involves one or two cusps without pulpal involvement
Only if the tooth is root-treated
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'The onlay is indicated for conservable cuspal fractures.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you are an expert!'

questions.question: 🗣️ Sami, talking to a patient, says: 'Composite can fix everything.' Mina intervenes: 'It has limits.' What are the limits of composite?
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Composite has limits that must be known.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will be more cautious in my indications.'

questions.question: 📞 Mina calls Sami: 'I have a patient with a cavity under a removable prosthesis!' Sami replies: 'We need to redo the prosthesis!' Mina says: 'What if we repaired it?' When can we repair under a prosthesis?
options: If the cavity is accessible without removing the prosthesis
Never, the prosthesis must be remade
Only if the prosthesis is resin
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Accessible cavities under a prosthesis can be repaired.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate the accessibility.'

questions.question: 🏥 Sami and Mina receive a patient with a fractured composite. Sami says: 'It's the patient's fault!' Mina replies: 'It might be a design flaw.' What is the most frequent cause?
options: Poor cavity preparation or insufficient thickness
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Fractures are often due to design defects.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you are really critical!'

questions.question: 🗣️ Sami, during a consultation, says: 'Your cavity is deep, we need an inlay.' Mina asks: 'Why not a direct composite?' What differentiates an inlay from a direct composite?
options: The inlay is laboratory-made and offers better resistance
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'The inlay is more resistant for extensive cavities.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you're right.'

questions.question: 📞 Sami calls Mina: 'I have a patient with a cavity under a composite veneer!' Mina replies: 'Can we repair it?' When can a composite veneer be repaired?
options: If the cavity is small and the veneer is functional
Never, the veneer must be remade
Only if the veneer is ceramic
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Small cavities under composite veneers can be repaired.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will repair this veneer.'

questions.question: 🏥 Sami and Mina receive a patient with recurrent caries on a root-treated tooth. Sami says: 'We need a crown!' Mina replies: 'And the post and core?' When is a post and core indicated?
options: When enough coronal structure remains for a crown
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'The post and core is indicated when the tooth can still receive a crown.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you are a real pro!'

questions.question: 🗣️ Sami, discussing with a patient, says: 'Glass ionomer is for poor patients.' Mina intervenes: 'It's an excellent material!' What are the advantages of glass ionomer?
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Glass ionomer has unique interesting properties.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will reevaluate this material.'

questions.question: 📞 Mina calls Sami: 'I have a patient with a cavity under an onlay!' Sami replies: 'We need to redo the onlay!' Mina says: 'What if we repaired it?' When can we repair under an onlay?
options: If the cavity is peripheral and accessible
Never, the onlay must be remade
Only if the onlay is composite
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Peripheral cavities under an onlay can be repaired.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate the possibility of repair.'

questions.question: 🏥 Sami and Mina receive a patient with a vertically fractured tooth. Sami says: 'We need a crown.' Mina replies: 'And extraction?' When is a vertically fractured tooth non-conservable?
options: If the fracture reaches the furcation or is deeply subgingival
Only if the tooth is root-treated
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Deep vertical fractures have a poor prognosis.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you are really an expert!'

questions.question: 🗣️ Sami, talking to a patient, says: 'Composite is the best material.' Mina intervenes: 'Amalgam still has indications.' When is amalgam still indicated?
options: For Class I and II cavities on posterior teeth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Amalgam still has indications in certain situations.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will think before choosing the material.'

questions.question: 📞 Sami calls Mina: 'I have a patient with a cavity under a bonded bridge!' Mina replies: 'Can we repair it?' When can a cavity under a bonded bridge be repaired?
options: If the cavity is accessible without removing the bridge
Never, the bridge must be remade
Only if the bridge is ceramic
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Accessible cavities under a bonded bridge can be repaired.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate the accessibility.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami and 🐆 Mina discuss the future of conservative dentistry. Sami says: 'CAD/CAM will replace composites!' Mina replies: 'It will complement them.' What is the future of conservative dentistry?
options: CAD/CAM complements conservative dentistry, but does not replace it
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'CAD/CAM is a complementary tool to conservative dentistry.' 🦅 Sami: 'I agree, we keep our know-how!'
